title: Pre-university years in China
summary: Opening frame for the chronicle. Kept restrained until university-era documents take over.

title: B.S. with Honors and the Xingyun Poetry Club
summary: Four years at USTC produced two first-author publications in atmospheric and space physics, plus the Xingyun Poetry Club, which Wu founded at age 17 and grew to over 1,197 members. Both arcs are publicly trackable and both anchor at USTC.

title: From directionless to interdisciplinary
summary: Two-and-a-half years as a Student Fellow at the Shenzhen X-Institute, the Shenzhen Municipal Government / Tsinghua University talent program. The People's Daily Overseas Edition profile (May 2025) framed this as the turning point — and Tsinghua University news republished it the same year.

title: Six months on the WACCM-X group at NCAR
summary: July to December 2023 in Boulder, Colorado. Hunga–Tonga eruption signature in the MLT region with Han-Li Liu's WACCM-X group, presented as AGU 2023 abstract SA33B-2892. The visiting-scholar period seeded the modeling familiarity that later shaped the UT Austin PhD.

title: AI agent evaluation and full-stack LLM (2025)
summary: Two 2025 internships between USTC and UT Austin: AI Agent Evaluation Engineer at PineAI and Full-Stack LLM Developer at Beijing ZaiwenAI Technology Co., Ltd. The 'AI for science' framing on the PhD side did not come from a textbook — it came from shipping LLM systems and evaluating agents at scale.

title: Explainable AI for Noah-MP, with Yang, Rempe, and Matheny
summary: Joined Jackson School of Geosciences as a Graduate Research Assistant in August 2024. Doctoral focus: model optimization of physics-based land surface models — Noah-MP, CTSM, HRLDAS — with explainable AI and machine learning integrated to improve plant–rock–water interaction simulation. AMS 2026 abstract co-authored with Yang, Rempe, Matheny, Mbarak, and Li.

title: Three pieces of national-tier coverage in twelve months
summary: People's Daily Overseas Edition (May 2025), Tsinghua University news republication (2025), and Mango TV / Hunan Television's 《夺金2026》Episode 1 (March 2026). The combined record bridges the Shenzhen fellowship and the Austin student-entrepreneur chapter.

title: Active research vehicle: NSF NCAR allocation UTAA0012 on Derecho-GPU
summary: The thesis: physics-based Earth system models and modern AI are not substitutes. The leverage is in using explainable AI to improve where Noah-MP gets plant–rock–water interactions wrong, then sending the upgraded physics back through the broader land–climate workflow. Day-to-day, that means HPC runs on NSF NCAR Derecho-GPU under allocation UTAA0012 with advisor Zong-Liang Yang.
